name: Nunchaku
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 20, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 143
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 20, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 143
Statistics
Cost 2 gp Weight 2 lbs.
Damage 1d4 (small), 1d6 (medium); Critical x2; Range —; Type B; Special disarm, monk
Category Light; Proficiency Exotic
Weapon Groups Flails; Monk
Description
A nunchaku is made up of two wooden or metal bars connected by a short length of rope or chain.
